reviews.title: Not sure if pro is worth it
reviews.text: I pay monthly to see recipes and tips for weight loss and exercise which is really nice. One downside is the food pal is a bit inaccurate. The app uses ai to input for meals and snacks and there’s no option to do that manually so the calorie, fat, carbs, and protein intake for some food items are wrong. For example I had a chomp stick, when I tried to log it I told the ai EXACTLY how many calories, carbs, fats, and grams of protein were in it, and it still wasn’t right. It’s not that big of a deal to me because I’m not that worried about calorie counting, it’s just a little annoying.

reviews.title: Useful fasting companion
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Litely for a while, and it has truly transformed my eating habits and overall well-being. The user friendly interface makes it easy to track my fasting and eating windows, and it sends timely reminders to keep our on track.🥰 one of the standout features of this app is the customized fasting plans, especially the personalized recipes. It takes into account my goals and lifestyle, offering a personal fasting schedule that suits my me perfectly. It’s like having a personal nutritionist in my pocket! I’m not very skilled at cooking, but Litely offers many simple recipes this is not only helps me lose weight but also boosts my confidence in the kitchen.
The progress tracking tools are motivating and provide a clear picture of my achievements. I love how I can see my fasting history, weights changes, and even my energy levels. It keeps me motivated to stay committed to my routine. I used to lack confidence because of my shape, and it even affected my health. But can you believe it? I managed to shed 15 pounds in just ONE month. I used to think that losing weight was tough, especially since I’m not big on exercise. But ever since I started using this fasting app, I’ve realized that it’s not as hard as I thought. With the right weight loss tool, I have been able to enjoy the journey and make it a part of my daily life. Overall, this app has been a game changer for me. It helped me shed some extra pounds, improve my energy level, and establish a healthier relationships with food.
So if you are looking to explore the world of intermittent fasting, i highly recommend giving Litely a try. It’s fantastic tool to help you on your journey to better health!

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: The fasting timer makes it easier to know what's happening in my body and also makes it much easier to stick to the plan by providing accountability (even if it's only to myself) and helping me feel like I'm accomplishing a goal every day. I also like that there are different kinds of challenges. They aren't too hard, but mostly get me to live healthy in a way that feels doable. I'm don't do a good job with restrictive diets, but intermittent fasting is proving to be quite simple, and I've noticed that my appetite during non-fasting periods is quite moderate, and I'm craving unhealthy foods less.
